_comment: Numeric shell probes for 1-1. Values are derived from the current baked colmesh (filesystem/lvl/1-1.colmesh) and committed — no test may capture expectations on first run. Each probe fires a ray from `origin` along `direction` up to `max_t` and asserts the result equals `expect`. On hit, `expected_normal` (returned normal faces the ray origin, per RaycastMesh) and `expected_material` are also checked within tolerance. Semantics per docs/1-1-shell-audit.md: west/north sides must be sealed by a wall (hit); east/south sides must NOT have floor geometry beyond the shell (miss).

probes.name: west_outer_wall_gap
probes.note: wall should seal the west shell edge

probes.name: east_floor_overrun
probes.note: floor should not continue beyond the east shell

probes.name: north_outer_wall_gap
probes.note: wall should seal the north shell edge

probes.name: south_floor_overrun
probes.note: floor should not continue beyond the south shell
